title: FC 402: Definitions
officialText:
402.1 Definitions.

The following terms shall, for the purposes of this chapter and as used elsewhere in this code, have the meaning set forth in FC 202.

ASSEMBLY AREA.

BUILDING OCCUPANTS.

COVERED MALL.

EMERGENCY SHELTER.

EVACUATION.

FEP.

FEP STAFF.

FIRE DRILL.

FLS.

FLS STAFF.

HIGH-RISE BUILDING.

HIGH-RISE FLOOR.

IN-BUILDING RELOCATION.

IN-BUILDING RELOCATION AREA.

LARGE-AREA BUILDING.

MIXED-OCCUPANCY BUILDING.

NON-FIRE EMERGENCY.

NON-FIRE EMERGENCY DRILL.

OFFICE BUILDING.

REGULAR BUSINESS HOURS.

SHELTER IN PLACE.

STAGED EVACUATION.

VOICE COMMUNICATION CAPABILITY.
